title: Prosecutors expand charges against ex-president Peña to criminal association
detail: Paraguay's prosecution expanded the Ueno Bank case against former president Santiago Peña to include criminal association (asociación criminal), on top of the earlier breach of trust and self-dealing administration charges. Per AFP-based reporting, prosecutors allege Peña acted as head of the structure from the Presidency; the expansion also reaches former central bank president Carlos Carvallo and four other ex-officials, per N+. Peña remains in pretrial detention. These are prosecution allegations, not findings of a court.

media.caption: Prosecutors accuse Peña of criminal association in Ueno Bank case
